name: patrol_monk_loop
about: sp_tutorial_1's monk_upstairs_podium loops its five nodes backward and stands at the podium (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/programs.md § 'Patrol paths, walked (2026-09-12, story 10g)'). The map's logic_auto sends SetupPatrolType '999 1 FOLLOW_PATROL_PATH_WALK' (t0) then FollowPatrolPath 'pod_1 pod_2 pod_3 pod_4 pod_5' (t+0.1); its logic_auto fires before a map record's time zero, so the record re-sends both verbatim. The player is set down 1.6 m from the monk at 0.1 s (the Society hub is out of the start's PVS, where retail's normal think law stretches to 16 s; the teleport wakes every NPC within 2048 units, 0x1028d820). Type 1 (table 0x1049df20: first index = last, step -1, next type 1) loops backward from pod_5: pod_5, pod_4, pod_3, pod_2, pod_1, then pod_5 again. pod_1's keys carry target_name 'upstairs podium' and ip_percent 100, so the interest roll 0x1029f650 always wins there: TASK_FACE_PATROL_INTEREST 0xb3 turns to the place (match_orientation 1) and TASK_DO_PATROL_INTEREST_ACTIVITY 0xb5 claims it through 0x102a9f40 and waits RandomFloat(10, 15) (the place's min_time/max_time), then its run arm releases it (0x102da600) and fires OnInterestingPlaceLeft; the other pods carry no record and both interest tasks complete at once. Points by map Y (cm): pod_5 -9307, pod_4 -8504, pod_3 -8424, pod_2 -8966, pod_1 -9510.
known_red: V4b (N13): the cruise speed is this body's own `walk_0` (136.683 cm/s, the male bank) and is right; the time is lost at arrival -- the body creeps the last ~30 cm for ~4 s before the kernel sees `arrived` (inferred from code until the B integrator toggles it; `packets-R1.md` item 4). monk_upstairs_podium is Elite_Hunter.mdl, which includes shared/male/npc_allsequences (the seam agent checked the model's include list; R1 did not run this record). No deadline moved
notes: taskdone of the podium activity cannot come before 10 s after it starts (min_time 10); the window is not pinned with a never because the trace's never takes no relative window (harness gap).
